source.label: ESSD paper (Gourmelon et al. 2022) glacier list; data on PANGAEA
source.method: one hand-placed terminus coordinate per glacier named in the paper; the PANGAEA zip has no per-image geolocation index

note: 681 SAR images (ERS, Envisat, RADARSAT-1, ALOS, TSX/TDX, S1; 1995-2020) of 7 glaciers: Columbia Glacier, Alaska; Jakobshavn Isbrae, Greenland; Mapple Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Crane Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Jorum Glacier, Antarctic Peninsula; Dinsmoor-Bombardier-Edgeworth, Antarctic Peninsula; Sjogren Inlet, Antarctic Peninsula. Test set = Mapple and Columbia.
